levels.name: Incoming damage +1 CAT

levels.name: Incoming damage +2 CAT

actions.name: Give orders
actions.description: Choose another crew member to act immediately on your turn. Resolve that action through their crew view. Do not advance initiative or expire effects as though their normal turn started.

actions.name: Pilot / Dash
actions.description: Move the ship up to its effective Speed in km. Use the separate +1G or -1G buttons as appropriate; the extension does not move map tokens.

actions.name: Adjust thrust (-1G)
actions.description: Companion to Pilot / Dash: reduce current Gs by 1.

actions.name: Thrust control (-5G)
actions.description: Reduce current Gs by 5.

actions.name: Dodge (+5G)
actions.description: Add 5G and gain advantage on DEX saves until the start of this crew member's next turn. While Optimize Routing is active, manually correct the cost to +2G.

actions.name: ATP Jump
actions.description: Spend 1 ATP Jump; requires ATP Jump route. GM must remove the route effect after use and adjudicate movement. Cannot jump while a navigation damage effect forbids it.

actions.name: Plan ATP Jump
actions.description: Add ATP Jump route. The route persists until used; GM removes it after a jump. Repeated planning should not stack routes.

actions.name: Plan an Evasive route
actions.description: Advantage on DEX saves until the start of this crew member's next turn.

actions.name: Optimize Routing
actions.description: Until the start of this crew member's next turn, halve G costs for actions that add Gs, rounded down. Manual: Dodge costs +2G; a +1G increment costs 0G. Adjust using the G buttons.

actions.name: Scan area
actions.description: Search roll: obtain additional surrounding-area data or find special areas. GM supplies results.

actions.name: PDC
actions.description: Attack 1d20 + Attack modifier; damage 1d12. No ammunition or cooldown. GM handles normal/long range.

actions.name: Covering Fire
actions.description: Any range. Prevents torpedo launches and deals damage on approach within 2 km. GM adjudicates the covered lane, duration, launch restrictions and damage; no damage formula was supplied.

actions.name: Ballistic Railgun
actions.description: One railgun cooldown slot of 1. Attack 1d20 + Attack; damage 1d8.

actions.name: Launch Fission Torpedo
actions.description: Use launches one torpedo, spends one round of ammunition and starts one available bay's cooldown of 2. Resolve 3d8 damage on impact. No attack roll was specified; GM handles travel, area and impact.

actions.name: Repair Drone
actions.description: Launch and roll 1d20 + Repair, then choose a Damage effect to remove on this ship after GM adjudicates success. Damage counters remain unchanged. For a drone sent to another ship, cancel the local selector and have the GM remove the target effect; launch costs remain spent.

actions.name: DMG Drone
actions.description: Use launches a drone at speed 1 km and spends one shared Drone Bay cooldown. Resolve Attack and Damage separately on arrival.

actions.name: Ship Scan
actions.description: Search roll: detect and identify nearby ships. GM supplies results.

actions.name: Counterhack
actions.description: Roll Hack, then select a Hack effect to remove. GM adjudicates success before confirmation; cancel if unsuccessful.

actions.name: Hack
actions.description: Roll Hack, choose a target ship, then confirm Target Locked if successful. GM adjudicates the roll and what Target Locked does; no numerical effect or duration was supplied.

grantsEffects.name: Target Locked
grantsEffects.description: Target Locked hack effect. GM adjudicates its benefits; remove with Counterhack or GM dismissal.

actions.name: Force Repair
actions.description: Spend 1 Autonomy. GM temporarily suppresses one Damage effect until the start of this crew member's next turn, then restores it if its original source still applies. Do not permanently remove it or reduce damage. Temporary suppression/restoration is manual.

actions.name: Reroute energy
actions.description: Choose exactly ONE positive and ONE negative allocation from different systems. The selector does not enforce this. Keep selected until rerouted; no expiry supplied. Weapon cooldown changes apply to future starts, not cooldowns already running. Arcane is currently disabled and has no usable action.

effects.name: Open Comms
effects.description: Negative Comms allocation. GM adjudicates consequences; no numerical penalty supplied.

effects.name: Shields Up
effects.description: Positive shield allocation. GM adjudicates benefits; no numerical value supplied.

effects.name: Shields Down
effects.description: Negative shield allocation. GM adjudicates consequences; no numerical value supplied.

levels.name: All disabled except pilot and weapons (2 turns)
levels.description: For two triggering crew turns, only piloting and weapons function. GM restricts other actions (including Counterhack); mixed pilot/weapon stations cannot be selectively blocked.

levels.name: Crew outside Pilot disabled
levels.description: GM disables the crew member outside the Pilot seat and reverses this when repaired. This follows crew, not just the Co-pilot station.

levels.name: Ship destroyed
levels.description: Blocks normal rolls at the affected stations. GM also enforces disabled non-roll actions and any crew disabling.

levels.name: Maximum 1 km / 15G
levels.description: Limits are recorded literally as supplied: Speed 1 km, maxG 15. Base Speed is already 1 km; maxG increases from the supplied base 10 to 15.

levels.name: Co-Pilot disabled
levels.description: Blocks normal rolls at the affected stations. GM also enforces disabled non-roll actions and any crew disabling.

levels.name: Navigation destroyed
levels.description: GM prevents navigation/piloting as appropriate; weapons remain independently usable.

levels.name: All weapons disabled
levels.description: GM prohibits PDC, Covering Fire and Ballistic Railgun. Mixed Pilot/Co-pilot stations remain available for piloting and Counterhack.

levels.name: Weapons destroyed
levels.description: GM prohibits all weapon use until repaired.
